flightPaths.departs: Published RNAV SIDs: straight out on 222 deg magnetic (about 230 deg true) over Gulf St Vincent to COLPY/BOVPU (min 2500 ft / 5000 ft), then either LEFT turn about 88 deg onto 134 deg to LEMAT then left again onto 078 deg towards the east (crossing the coast around Brighton to Port Noarlunga and the southern suburbs at 5000+ ft), or RIGHT turn about 90 deg onto 312 deg to KEEFO (north-west along the gulf), or straight on 234-256 deg to DERWY/GILES (south-west). Master Plan Fig 13-2 shows the same: a bundle going offshore ~8-10 km then curving left to cross the coast far to the south, plus some tracks going north-west up the gulf. Turn point is offshore, not 6 km after take-off over land.
flightPaths.arrives: Arrivals to 23 fly ILS-Z/LOC-Z RWY 23 straight final on 222 deg from MOPRI (10.1 NM, about 19 km) and VIRAT (14.2 NM, about 26 km) from the north-east: over Walkerville/Prospect/Thebarton/inner north-east then the airport. Straight final at least 19-26 km: our 26 km straight-in is right.

flightPaths.note: Left/right turns are about 90 deg (left continues to about 145 deg total). The turn happens offshore at an unpublished distance (waypoint coordinates not in the AIP text I could read), so the map's 6 km straight is too short; consider depKm ~10 before the turn. Noise on land from 23 departures is minimal until the southern coast crossing. Night: all curfew-permitted ops use 05 arrivals and 23 departures (Master Plan 13.3).

flightPaths.departs: Published RNAV SIDs: straight on 042 deg magnetic (about 050 deg true) over Thebarton/CBD/Walkerville to MOPRI (about 10 NM / 19 km NE; at or above 5000 ft), then LEFT about 70 deg onto 312 deg to SARAG (north-west), LEFT about 48 deg onto 354 deg to ORBUN (north), RIGHT about 14 deg onto 056 deg to UPROT (north-east), or (SID with KNOBL) turn right after KNOBL at 1700 ft direct to ROGGS then east on 078/102 deg. Master Plan Fig 13-2 and Fig 13-4 show departures from 05 fanning out beyond the CBD to north-west (over Port Adelaide), north, north-east and east (Adelaide Hills), with a tight right-turn bundle back east/south-east.
flightPaths.arrives: Arrivals to 05 come over Gulf St Vincent: RNP Z RWY 05 / ILS-RNP from the south-west and north-west over water, straight final for ~15 NM (PADSI/PADSF fixes 15 and about 5 NM). Straight 26 km is fine; this end is over water.

Daytime 05 departures were 10% (Jan 2018) and 28% (Aug 2018) of main-runway departure use.

airportLand.osm: way 146489105 (aeroway=aerodrome, icao=YPAD, operator Adelaide Airport Limited)
airportLand.note: Polygon exists but covers only ~504 ha (bbox 138.5144-138.5474 E, -34.9607 to -34.9342 N). The 2019 Master Plan ch.2 says the airport site is approximately 785 hectares, so the OSM polygon is about 64% of the official area (probably omits some leased non-aviation precincts). Shaded land would be visibly smaller than the lease. Source: https://corporate.adelaideairport.com.au/planning-building/airport-master-plan/ ; https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/146489105

About 398 ha; Parafield Airport states a site of approximately 433 ha (Master Plan 2024), ~92%, plausible match. Source: https://www.parafieldairport.com.au/wp-content/uploads/Preliminary-Draft-Master-Plan-Summary.pdf (via search); https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/2368427
